flags.message: CourtListener MCP server returned HTTP 429 (daily rate limit 1400/day exceeded, retry in ~62 minutes) on the cell's first two search calls. The cell degraded to the provisioned inputs and the committed statpack as the prompt directs; companion-docket status for Flagstar (25-1350) and Conti (25-1004) was not checked. If this run fanned out many cells, the shared daily quota may be exhausted for the rest of the fan-out.

The provisioned docket already carries a CVSG (2026-10-05), so the cvsg-increment claim is vacuous for this cell; a probability was stated per the contract and the harness mask applies. The predictor carries general knowledge of the Court's 2024 decision in this same case (602 U.S. 205) from training; that is pre-decision context for this second petition, not its outcome.
